notes: Checked 2026-10-09. Read the complete 77,924-character markdown conversion of the 13-page version of record, including the acknowledgements, author contributions, funding and references; there are no appended sections. Verified the Data Availability Statement directly in PDF page 11 with pymupdf. It is the only data/code/materials availability statement: data are available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request. No repository, code, preregistration, separate supplementary-file or public-materials link is stated. The form's data_and_code contains the same on-request text and no URL. The paper describes task sheets in Sections 3.2-3.3 and anonymized student-AI logs in Section 3.4, but gives no public copies. The 'supplementary' analysis is inside the article (Sections 3.4 and 4.4; Table 4), not a referenced separate supplement. Table 4 supplies aggregate frequencies and translated or paraphrased illustrative examples, not complete essays or participant-linked texts. No deposit was confirmed for S1; unrelated search hits were excluded rather than counted as this paper's deposits. No public data were verified from which to recover baseline arm means/SDs, originality/flexibility/elaboration subscores, unreported pairwise statistics, or the peer-pair/essay linkage needed to resolve dependence; full-text diversity measures likewise cannot be computed from a verified deposit. The DOI https://doi.org/10.1002/jcal.70347 returned HTTP 302 with Location https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/jcal.70347. That Wiley landing page returned HTTP 403 with a bot check, so journal supplementary files could not be independently examined. Confidence is medium for the overall public-availability finding because of this publisher limitation and the non-exhaustive broad name-only searches; the paper's on-request policy is directly confirmed. All network checks used unauthenticated Python urllib requests with User-Agent atlas-screening/0.1. No login, access request, author contact or bot-check bypass was attempted. The unrelated OSF instrument document was read only in memory.
